cases:
CREATE TABLE cases (
    id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('New', 'InReview', 'Closed'))
) STRICT
case_creation_keys:
CREATE TABLE "case_creation_keys" (
    "request_key" TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_case_creation_keys" PRIMARY KEY,
    "case_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "AK_case_creation_keys_case_id" UNIQUE ("case_id"),
    CONSTRAINT "CK_creation_key_uuid" CHECK (length(request_key) = 36
AND instr(request_key, char(0)) = 0
AND substr(request_key, 9, 1) = '-'
AND substr(request_key, 14, 1) = '-'
AND substr(request_key, 19, 1) = '-'
AND substr(request_key, 24, 1) = '-'
AND length(replace(request_key, '-', '')) = 32
AND replace(request_key, '-', '') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
AND request_key <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'),
    CONSTRAINT "FK_case_creation_keys_cases_case_id" FOREIGN KEY ("case_id") REFERENCES "cases" ("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT
) STRICT
case_status_history:
CREATE TABLE "case_status_history" (
    "case_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "kind" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "from_status" TEXT NULL,
    "to_status" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "recorded_at_utc" TEXT NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "PK_case_status_history" PRIMARY KEY ("case_id", "sequence"),
    CONSTRAINT "CK_history_from" CHECK (from_status IS NULL OR from_status IN ('New', 'InReview', 'Closed')),
    CONSTRAINT "CK_history_kind" CHECK (kind IN ('Created', 'Baseline', 'StatusChanged')),
    CONSTRAINT "CK_history_sequence" CHECK (sequence BETWEEN 1 AND 3),
    CONSTRAINT "CK_history_to" CHECK (to_status IN ('New', 'InReview', 'Closed')),
    CONSTRAINT "CK_history_transition" CHECK ((sequence = 1 AND kind = 'Created' AND from_status IS NULL AND to_status = 'New')
OR (sequence = 1 AND kind = 'Baseline' AND from_status IS NULL)
OR (sequence BETWEEN 2 AND 3 AND kind = 'StatusChanged' AND from_status IS NOT NULL
    AND ((from_status = 'New' AND to_status = 'InReview')
        OR (from_status = 'InReview' AND to_status = 'Closed')))),
    CONSTRAINT "FK_case_status_history_cases_case_id" FOREIGN KEY ("case_id") REFERENCES "cases" ("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT
) STRICT
__EFMigrationsHistory:
CREATE TABLE "__EFMigrationsHistory" (
    "MigrationId" TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK___EFMigrationsHistory" PRIMARY KEY,
    "ProductVersion" TEXT NOT NULL
)
